title: [FR] Delocalize delayed VAT and SEPA payment-slip integration
summary: Moved French delayed VAT and SEPA direct debit payment-slip features from base layers to the Payment Management FR app, while maintaining reusable posting and calculation engines in the base application.
key_points: Extracted delayed VAT recognition and payment slip logic into Payment Management FR app
Moved journal-context fields and unrealized application buffer to app level with data migration
Implemented app subscribers to route VAT and validation logic through standard calculation
Extracted source-document export-error linking into the app
Updated permissions, data classification, and cloud-migration lists
quote: Complete the remaining French delayed-VAT and payment-slip SEPA direct-debit extraction into the existing Payment Management FR app.
